description: Nestled beneath the canopy of a majestic cedar in Oakland's King Estates neighborhood, this spacious 1940s home presents an exceptional opportunity to restore, renovate and reimagine a property with scale and timeless character. Offering approximately 2,168 square feet, the home features generous rooms, abundant natural light, original hardwood floors, classic built-ins, period light fixtures and a thoughtfully designed floor plan that has served generations well.
